newsitem.title: UK: Hodder Headline says 1997 off to good start.
newsitem.headline: Hodder Headline says 1997 off to good start.

text.p: British book publisher Hodder Headline Plc said that it had made a good start to trading this year and saw signs of better UK markets.
"1997 has started well and it is possible to detect signs of more robust UK consumer and educational markets," chief executive Tim Hely Hutchinson said.
"As was the case in 1996, we expect much stronger results in the second half of the year than in the first half and we are of course aiming to achieve good progress in the year as a whole."
Hodder Headline reported a 16 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 6.6 million stg in 1996.
The company is paying a final dividend of 4.5 pence per share, leaving the total for the year unchanged at 6.5.
